description: Deprecated: use kb_research. Ask a question over the whole KnowMan library by default (Inbox and Knowledge Base; pass scope to narrow to kb or inbox), or a single item when itemId is given; returns an answer plus citations whose itemId resolves via kb_get_item. Answers specific questions with citations; may abstain on broad questions: then use kb_memories, kb_search and kb_get_item.

itemId.description: Optional item id restricting the question.

projectId.description: Optional project id restricting the question.

question.description: Question to ask over the KnowMan Knowledge Base.

scope.description: Which part of the library to search: all (default): the whole library, Inbox and Knowledge Base; kb: Knowledge Base only; inbox: Inbox only. Ignored when itemId is given.

name: kb_ask
title: Ask your knowledge base
